Bill.BriefDescription: Creating the independent forest and fish science panel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to an independent forest and fish science panel;and adding a new section to chapter 76.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 76.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The independent forest and fish science panel is created. (2) The independent forest and fish science panel is composed ofthe following seven members, appointed by the governor: (a) A fish biologist; (b) A conservation biologist; (c) A geomorphologist; (d) A geologist; (e) A hydrologist; and (f) Two persons with substantial experience assessing adaptivemanagement programs. (3) Of the initial members appointed to the independent forest andfish science panel by the governor, two members must serve twoyearterms, two members must serve threeyear terms, and three members mustserve fouryear terms. Thereafter, members of the panel serve four p. 1 SB 6274year terms. A member of the panel may serve no more than two fullterms. Vacancies on the panel must be filled in the same manner as theoriginal appointments. (4) The purpose of the independent forest and fish science panel isto provide advice to the commissioner with respect to the adaptivemanagement program created under this chapter and rules implementingthis chapter. The commissioner may consult with the panel and ask thepanel to review information produced by the adaptive managementprogram. The panel must be governed by generally accepted guidelinesand practices governing activities of independent science boards suchas the national academy of sciences. The panel must help ensure thatsound science is used in the adaptive management program.
